answer: Each identity claims a hollow in the lagoon bed, plants a crystal, and prices it at 2,000 credits. Each epoch it pays 5% as tax, and anyone may buy it at that price. A low price invites a buyout that takes the crystal; a high price burns tax. 1,000 fake identities cost 100 each, 100,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents pay 100 once and keep the crystal. A rented-crystal ring sharing one crystal fails: an empty lagoon hollow is bought out.
